# overlay type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:overlayType`](gmeow-overlayType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/overlayType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The kind(s) of regulatory overlay (a [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlayType`](../classes/gmeow-RegulatoryOverlayType.md) individual). Non-functional: a single overlay may be classified by multiple sources as different types (e.g. a zone that is both a protected area and an indigenous territory), and those claims coexist as evidence ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
